title: Install the app
intro: BeatApp installs straight from the browser, with no app store involved. Once installed it opens like a normal app and works offline.

scan.title: Scan or share
scan.alt: QR code pointing to the BeatApp address
scan.hint: Point your phone camera at this code: the address opens directly.

share.title: BeatApp
share.text: Beat-synced reels, right in your browser.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address by hand.

ios.title: iPhone and iPad — Safari
ios.step1: Open the address in Safari. Installing does not work from Chrome or Firefox on iOS.
ios.step2: Tap the Share button, the square with an upward arrow, at the bottom of the screen.
ios.step3: Scroll the list and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
ios.step4: Confirm with “Add”. The icon appears on your home screen.
ios.note: On iOS only Safari can install a web app: that is an Apple restriction, not a shortcoming of the app.

android.title: Android — Chrome
android.step2: An “Install app” banner may appear: that is enough, just tap it.
android.step3: Otherwise, open the ⋮ menu at the top right.
android.step4: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”, then confirm.
android.note: Firefox and Samsung Internet offer the same thing, named “Add to Home screen”.

desktop.title: Computer — Chrome or Edge
desktop.step1: Open the address in Chrome or Edge.
desktop.step2: Look for the install icon at the right of the address bar: a screen with a downward arrow.
desktop.step4: The app opens in its own window and is added to your Start menu or your Dock.
desktop.note: Safari on Mac also installs web apps, through the File menu then “Add to Dock”.

why.title: What installing changes
why.body: The app opens full screen, with no address bar, and launches from your home screen. It works without a connection, and your projects stay saved on the device. Nothing is sent to a server, before or after installing.
